title: Implement the disposable storage-rehearsal harness
goal: After T001/T002 are terminal and T006 has integrated them into one exact reviewed Heim-PC source revision, implement and review the effect-free storage/recovery rehearsal harness from that exact T006 base. The harness encodes the canonical GPT + EFI + recovery + LUKS2 + Btrfs topology, disposable-target preflight, restore/reconstruction workflow and evidence readback contracts without executing partitioning, formatting, LUKS creation or boot mutation.

approval.note: This task is implementation-only and must start from the exact T006 integration commit/tree, not moving main. It may change and test only the rehearsal implementation paths but may not execute sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs, boot mutation or equivalent block-device effects. Final source integration is delegated to T007 and the real disposable rehearsal to T003.

acceptance.assertion: The T005 worktree is created from the exact terminal T006 integration commit/tree and its reviewed receipt, and ancestry readback proves that exact revision is the immutable base. Moving main, an unbound branch tip, a different integration commit or missing T006 evidence fails closed before repository mutation.

The reviewed rehearsal harness declaratively encodes GPT + EFI System Partition + recovery/boot-recovery surface + LUKS2 + Btrfs with exactly @root, @nix, @persist, @home, @data and @containers, and tests reject topology drift.

The harness requires an explicitly supplied blank disposable target and cannot infer or default to a production block device; missing target identity fails closed before any destructive command could be constructed.

Preflight logic requires fresh target/backing evidence and rejects any target matching the productive Heim-PC root backing, mounted production filesystems or current production device identity; historical nvme0n1/SN850X references are never accepted as current authority.

Partitioning, wipe, LUKS, filesystem and boot commands are generated/executed only behind a runtime executor that requires separate exclusive sandbox authority; unit tests prove this repository task cannot cross that boundary.
The harness implements independent readback that verifies GPT partitions, LUKS2 unlock, Btrfs filesystem and all required subvolumes/mounts rather than trusting command exit status alone.

The harness defines staged restore and fresh-system reconstruction checks that consume independently sourced off-host backup material without requiring the production system SSD, Grabowski, Bureau or network during the offline-recovery proof.

Evidence schemas separately bind backup coverage, restore usability, bootable recovery media, offline source/lock/trust roots and LUKS/recovery material; a currently green scoped backup alone cannot satisfy full-cutover recovery readiness.

This task terminates without source integration, main-branch merge, sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs, real EFI mutation, Secure-Boot key mutation, firmware write, productive nixos-install, productive switch, reboot into a new OS or equivalent block-device/runtime effect. T007 owns final source integration.

Focused effect-free harness, target-guard, topology-readback and recovery-contract tests plus required repository CI are green on the exact reviewed T005 head descended from the bound T006 integration revision before T005 is terminal.

metadata.historical_device_reference_not_authorit: WD_BLACK SN850X 2TB / historical nvme0n1 orientation only; never a default or current target
